title: Awesome self-guided tour!
text: This tour was amazing and we downloaded it before we started our journey. The nice thing about it was that you could stop and start as you went along in case you wanted to look at something most more closely. It uses GPS to know where you are and then helps you go to the next tour point. The fact that you had a map that followed along with you as you walked, helped you ascertain the directions you're given as well. A fun way to see a city on your own terms. Thank you, Alba!
author: Ruth_R

title: Great Self Guided Tour
